set.prevailing_wage_basis: No program rule found. The City funding page, the 2020, 2021 and 2023 NOFAs and staff reports, and the Sept 2024 application process report do not state a prevailing wage requirement for Trust Fund awards. The April 2024 Marin Villa Estates staff report notes prevailing wage applied to that project through multiple layered funding sources, not through the City fund itself. Coverage of a City-only award rests on the general Labor Code 1720(b) public-funds definition and depends on 1720(c) exemptions and project facts.
